name: U-Best Innovative Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: U-Best Innovative Technology Co., Ltd., a company founded in Tainan City, Taiwan in 1991, primarily specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of various synthetic resin products, with a strong focus on polyurethane (PU) formulations. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of chemical solutions, including PU synthetic resins, specialized PU adhesives, surface treatment agents, and solvents. They also supply nylon resins, polyester polyols, raw materials for composite products, water-based resins, bridging agents, and wet curing reaction products. Furthermore, the company develops and offers advanced materials such as thermoplastic polyurethanes (TPUs) and flexible OLED hard coat films. These diverse offerings find critical applications across numerous sectors. They are integral to the production of materials for sports footwear, provide essential functionalities like fire resistance, anti-fouling properties, and waterproof/moisture-permeable capabilities. U-Best's products are also key components in the furniture, apparel, and leather goods industries, in addition to serving a broad spectrum of other industrial requirements. Beyond its core chemical business, U-Best Innovative Technology Co., Ltd. also maintains a real estate division, engaged in the development and leasing of residential properties.
